selection_rationale: Highest development ROC-AUC and PR-AUC; current+Biomed fusion was lower on both point estimates.
Deterministic |axis_angle_deg| ranking substantially outperformed RAD-DINO and BiomedCLIP on development OOF.
Standalone RAD-DINO retained: current+RAD produced only a very small ROC increase while lowering PR-AUC, and the paired bootstrap did not show a stable fusion advantage.
Predeclared specialist mean retained: ROC was essentially tied with specialist max while PR-AUC was higher. No fitted fusion weights were used.
Frozen fixed 50/50 fusion improved development ROC-AUC and PR-AUC over both the current baseline and frozen C2 replay.
Geometry/FOV specialist gave the strongest development ROC/PR combination among the retained ROI candidates.
Highest development ROC-AUC and PR-AUC among the retained fixed hip-quality formulas; conservative RAD-DINO gating is used only inside overall hip quality.
